subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom given below:
"Steal a march on someone"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Gain an advantage secretly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Steal a march on someone"** refers to secretly or unexpectedly gaining an advantage over someone. (किसी पर गुप्त रूप से या अप्रत्याशित रूप से बढ़त हासिल करना)
 
 
• **Example:** By launching their product a week earlier, the company managed to steal a march on its competitors.
 
 
• This idiom implies a strategic or clever move that provides an upper hand. (यह रणनीतिक या चतुर चाल को दर्शाता है जो बढ़त प्रदान करता है)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Gain an advantage secretly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Imitate someone's tactics** (किसी की रणनीति की नकल करना) — This refers to copying or mimicking someone's strategies or actions.
 
 
• **Example:** The rookie player imitated the tactics of his mentor to improve his game.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: Win by cheating** (धोखाधड़ी से जीतना) — This refers to achieving victory through dishonest or unfair practices.
 
 
• **Example:** The team was disqualified for winning by cheating during the final match.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: Announce plans publicly** (योजनाओं को सार्वजनिक रूप से घोषित करना) — This refers to revealing or making plans known to the public.
 
 
• **Example:** The company announced their expansion plans publicly during the press conference.
